newsitem.title: USA: Eljer Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Eljer Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it cut its stake in Eljer Industries Inc to 649,407 common shares, or 9.08 percent from 10.98 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 105,700 common shares sold between December 17 and December 24 at prices ranging from $23.5742 to $23.6250 per share.
Eljer is based in Dallas, Texas and is a plumbing, heating equipment and air-conditioning products manufacturer.
